   公司簡介 
川湖成立於 1986 年，初期生產辦公室鉸鏈與滑軌、家具五金配件產品，現為導軌製
造商，以自有品牌 King Slide 行銷產品，導軌用途涵蓋伺服器、廚具以及工業，伺服
器導軌為最大宗產品，客戶包括品牌廠(Dell、HP、IBM)與白牌客戶。    
投資評等/目標價 重點摘要

【大盤指數/股價】44226 / 11110

➢ 川湖 2Q26 毛利率飆升，EPS 創歷單季新高 
川湖 2Q26 營收為 108.3 億元，QoQ+98.7%，YoY+156.1%，毛利率
87.4%，營益率 82.1%，EPS 74.38 元，營收、獲利創單季新高，大幅優
於投研部預期。AI 伺服器需求強勁帶動川湖營收爆發性成長，公司產能
利用率由 1Q26 的 60%，提升至 2Q26 的 70%~80%；2Q26 毛利率
QoQ+9.7ppts，YoY+9.9ppts，大幅上升的原因包含 IP 帶來的效益(公
司擁有 3,800 項專利)、自動化生產使效率提升、高單價/高毛利產品出
貨增加等 。 除了上述因素 ， 影響公司毛利率的因子還有匯率(台幣升貶 1%
對毛利率影響數 0.5%~0.6%)，鋼材漲跌的對毛利率的影響相對小。  
➢ 7 月營收突破 60 億元，2H26 HoH 增幅樂觀  
川湖 7 月營收為 64.1 億元，MoM+44.2%，YoY+355.5%，單月營收再
度突破歷史新高紀錄，2H26 持續有新品量產，公司表示 2H26 HoH 幅
度值得期待。川湖在全球擁有數百家客戶，包含四大 CSP 以及新的
Hyperscalers，公司認為 2027 年~2029 年的滑軌設計創新性更高，因
此術門檻極高、難度大，川湖能夠達成由模具到量產的快速更新，對於
未來商機展望十分正向。投研部預估川湖 3Q26 營收為 165.5 億元，
QoQ+52.8%，YoY+278.7%，EPS 為 99.50 元。  
川湖看到 2027 年~2029 年 AI 伺服器、Rack 滑軌需求強勁，在台灣、
美國持續擴產 ， 最新進度有：1)美國休士頓廠為高度自動化產線 ， 預計9
月試機量產；2)川益第三期、第五期將提早動工，川益三期、五期預計
2026 年底動工(比原定提早 1~2 年)， 投資規模達百億 ， 二個廠房面積共
22 萬米平方。 
➢ 維持買進建議，目標價 14,300 元 
川湖 2Q26 營收、獲利大躍進，毛利率表現亮眼，公司表示 2H26 持續
有新品量產，營運展望樂觀，且已經與客戶著手規劃 2027 年~2029 年
之產品，川湖已在台灣、美國擴產以因應長期需求的攀升。川湖PE 區間
位於 10X~28X， 考量公司在AI 伺服器市場具主導地位 ， 握有多達3,800
項的專利，建議買進，目標價 14,300 元(2027F PE 30X)。

美國廠 9 月投產，2026 年底川益三期、五期動工 
川湖看到 2027 年~2029 年 AI 伺服器、Rack 滑軌需求強勁，本次法說宣布川益第三
期、第五期將提早動工，目前產能布局為：1)川湖一廠(路竹廠)，生產傳統鋼珠滑軌、
烤漆滑軌及隱藏式鉸鏈等家具與廚具五金；2)川湖二廠已於 2025 年底動工，包含智
慧化生產基地與員工宿舍，預計 2027 年~2028 年完成，目標再增加 20%產能；3)川
益廠一期、二期，主要用來生產伺服器導軌與相關精密滑軌 ；4)川益三期、五期預計
2026 年底動工(比原定提早 1~2 年)，投資規模達百億，二個廠房面積共 22 萬米平方
(川益 1+2 廠的 11 萬平方米的 2 倍)；5)美國休士頓廠為高度自動化產線，預計 9 月
試機量產，美國廠美國廠產品價格已經和客戶取得共識，川湖認為不需擔心利潤率問
題。

研究部對川湖維持買進投資建議，主係 : (1) 2Q26 營收與獲利大幅
優於預期，毛利率飆升至 87.4%，創歷史新高；(2) 7 月單月營收已
站穩 60 億元以上，管理層對下半年展望正向；(3) 美國廠下半年進
入量產，並持續投入三、五期廠房，面積為二期規模的一倍，未來產
能無虞；(4) 新平台單價大幅提升，川湖產業護城河持續強化。綜上
所述，研究部上修 2027 年營收至 824 億元(原估 346 億元)，年增
56.9%，EPS 上修至 534.41 元(原估 207.00 元)，給予 29 倍本益比，
目標價上修至 15,500 元。

重點摘要： 
1. 2Q26營收獲利同步噴出，毛利率飆升至87.4%創新高 :  
2Q26營收108億元(原估64億元)，季增98.7%，年增156.1%，較
原預期大幅超越68.4%，主因HGX B300、GB300與ASIC AI伺服
器需求強勁所致。毛利率87.4%(原估77.0%)，季增9.7pts，大
幅優於研究部預期，主係產品效率提升、經濟規模效益，營益
率82.1%(原估68.4%)，季增15.0pts。業外收支2.29億元，EPS
達74.38元(原估38.97元)，優於預期。。

2. 7月營收站穩60億元以上，3Q26同步大幅上修 
7月營收64億元，月增44%，年增356%，較2Q26單月均值(約
36億元)明顯跳升，管理層指引產能利用率已達70~80%。研究
部考量下半年VR新平台 、ASIC陸續放量 ， 加上休士頓新產能陸
續開出，研究部上修 3Q26營收至179.6億元(原估69.5億元)，
EPS上修至116.38元(原估40.27元)。

3. 新平台單價優於預期，2027年大幅上修 
根據供應鏈調查，川湖在新一代導軌單價(不論在VR、AWS T3、
AMD平台)，遠高於研究部先前預期，故目前已大幅上修上修
2027年營收至824億元(原估346億元)。市佔方面，由於平台迭
代快速，供應商需在NPI早期即參與開發，才能快速配合客戶
設計，故川湖具備先行者優勢，預估川湖在AI伺服器機櫃滑軌
(GPU、ASIC) 市佔率超過八~九成，HGX、客製化機櫃等，因進
入門檻更高，預估有望達獨佔地位，川湖持續居導軌產業龍頭
地位。

4. 產能佈局到位，美國廠下半年投產 
產能方面，美國(休士頓)廠預計3Q26末投產，就近支援美系客
戶需求。此外，二期廠區面積約11萬平方公尺，預期再投入三
期、五期廠區，面積合計約22萬平方公尺(為原二期規模的一
倍)，預計今年底左右動工，投資金額預估約100億元，將導入
更多自動化產線，有助提升生產效率並強化市場競爭力。 。

5. 產業地位穩固，大幅上修獲利並維持買進 
綜上所述，研究部上修2026年營收至525億元(原估260億元)，
年增200%，EPS上修至348.50元(原估160.66元)。並同步上修
2027年營收至824億元(原估346億元)，年增56.9%，EPS上修至
534.41元(原估207.00元)。考量2Q財報大幅優於預期、下半年
產能持續開出，且護城河優勢持續強化，給予29倍本益比，目
標價上修至15,500元(2027 EPS*29 PER)，維持買進建議。

2344 華邦電(Winbond)

報告日期： 2026/08/07  研 究 員：翁浩軒 (Davy Wong) 
壹、投 資 建 議

一. 2Q26 毛利率優於預期，EPS 5.4 元 
華邦電 2Q26 營收 598.43 億(QoQ+56.44%、YoY+184.72%)，其中記
憶體事業營收 517 億(QoQ+72.8%、YoY+303.1%)，2Q26 毛利率大
幅跳升至 66.25%，主要因記憶體價格上漲，營業費用提升 28 億主
要因提列員工獎金，稅後淨利 243.17 億，EPS 5.4 元。

二.  2026 記憶體維持上漲格局，預估 EPS 23.68 元 
展望 2026 下半年，預估記憶體求維持強勁下，價格持續上漲，唯
因價格基期已高，加上傳統消費性產品追價力道有限，漲幅不若
上半年，不過預估今年隨著價格上漲，加上製程轉換帶動位元出
貨量增加，營收逐季成長，預估華邦電 2026 年營收 2578.49 億
(YoY+188.4%) ， 稅後淨利 1065.38 億(YoY+2589.04%) ， EPS 23.68 元 。

三.  2027 年記憶體更加緊缺，預估 EPS 43.57 元 
展望 2027 年，AI 帶動之記憶體缺貨狀況延續，加上全球新增產能
有限，緊缺情況更加嚴峻。DDR4 在全球三大廠逐步退出下價格將
維持高檔，NOR Flash 及 SLC NAND 亦因供給端增產有限，價格逐
步回升 ， 其中 SLC Nand 因大廠退出 ， 華邦將成為全球最大供應商 ，
而應用於 AI Server 的高容量 NOR Flash 持續供不應求，預期將推
升價格上行至 2027 年。因應記憶體需求強勁，高雄廠產能將由現
在 15k 擴充至年底的 24k，屆時位元出貨量可望翻倍，同時啟動高
雄 Module B 投資計劃，規劃月產能可達 50k~60k ，將分階段擴充，
預估 2029 年底量產。預估 2027 年營收 4077.20 億(YoY+58.12%)，
稅後淨利 1960.56 億(YoY+84.02%)，EPS 43.57 元

四. 投資建議：買進，目標價 240 元  
華邦電為全球最大 NOR Flash 廠亦是利基型 DRAM 廠，AI 帶動各
式記憶體需求增加，產能仍供不應求下，獲利將逐季成長。公司
針對邊緣 AI 發展之 CUBE 解決方案將於 2027 年開始貢獻 ， 矽電容
亦為新的業務機會，中長期而言 AI、HPC、IoT、自駕車等新產品
新應用將帶動更多記憶體需求。考量到 1) AI 帶動之記憶體供不應
求將延續至 2028 年、2)華邦電今明年營收獲利創高、3)CUBE、矽
電容具成長潛力 ， 參考 2027 年 EPS 給予 5.5 倍本益比 ， 目標價 240
元，建議買進。

貳、公 司 營 運 概 況

一.公司簡介 
華邦電子於 1987 年九月由華新麗華集團轉投資成立，為自有品牌
IC 設計及製造廠商，並為全世界第五大 DRAM 供應商，且為國內
少數擁有晶圓廠之積體電路設計公司，同時也是全球利基型記憶
體的主要供應商。2008 年公司將邏輯 IC 事業分割成立新唐科技，
新唐產品線以消費性電子 IC 、電腦 IC 兩大產品線為主，並同時擁
有一座 6 吋晶圓廠。華邦電在 NOR Flash 為全球最大供應商，產
品上從中低容量市場拓展至中高容量市場。2Q26 記憶體產品營收
依應用面而言：消費性電子占 28%、車用&工業用占 28%、通訊電
子占 29%、電腦占 15%。NOR Flash 主要同業為旺宏、兆易創新、
Infineon。

二.2026 年營運概況及展望  
1. 2Q26 毛利率優於預期，EPS 5.4 元 
華邦電 2Q26 營收 598.43 億(QoQ+56.44%、YoY+184.72%)，其中記
憶體事業營收 517 億(QoQ+72.8%、YoY+303.1%)，主要受惠於記憶
體價格價格走揚，DRAM 營收季增 78%，其中價格季增 100%，位
元出貨量季減 10%; Flash 營收季增 65% ，其中價格季增 40% ，位元
出貨量季增 15%，產能利用率維持近 100% 。2Q26 毛利率大幅跳升
至 66.25%，主要因記憶體價格上漲，營業費用提升 28 億主要因
RD 費用增加，加上提列員工獎金，稅後淨利 243.17 億，EPS 5.4
元。市場應用別而言，通訊電子、消費電子、車用&工業用、電腦
等應用營收均較上季季增高雙位數。

2. 2026 下半年記憶體維持上漲格局，預估 2026 年 EPS 23.68 元 
展望 2026 下半年，預估記憶體求維持強勁下，價格持續上漲，唯
因價格基期已高，加上傳統消費性產品追價力道有限，漲幅不若
上半年，不過預估今年隨著價格上漲，加上製程轉換帶動位元出
貨量增加，及新產能貢獻，營收逐季成長，毛利率持續提升，預
估華邦電 2026 年營收 2578.49 億(YoY+188.4%)，毛利率 67.75%，
稅後淨利 1065.38 億(YoY+2589.04%)，EPS 23.68 元。

3. 2027 年記憶體更加緊缺，預估 EPS 43.57 元 
展望 2027 年，AI 帶動之記憶體缺貨狀況延續，加上全球新增產能
有限，緊缺情況更加嚴峻，而儘管終端電子產品需求不一，不過
未來 AI 落地後每單位產品之記憶體搭載量持續成長，使得記憶體
位元出貨提升 ，2027 年公司營運仍正向 。DDR4 在全球三大廠逐步
退出下價格自 2Q25 起漲，且因終端電子產品仍有一定需求，價格

將維持高檔，NOR Flash 及 SLC NAND 亦因供給端增產有限，價格
逐步回升，其中 SLC Nand 因大廠退出，華邦將成為全球最大供應
商，而應用於 AI Server 的高容量 NOR Flash 持續供不應求，預期
將推升價格上行至 2027 年。華邦電製程技術方面，20 奈米 DRAM
產品仍為主要出貨主力，應用於 DDR3、DDR4、LPDDR 產品，16
奈米製程已開發完成，2027 年將有一定比例轉換至 16 奈米；NOR 
Flash 營收穩定成長 ， NAND Flash 24 奈米及 32 奈米 SLC Nand 今年
2Q 貢獻顯著提升。 因應記憶體需求強勁， 公司 Flash 與 DRAM 擴
產計畫進行中，華邦電 2025 年資本支出為台幣 55 億元，2026 年
將提升至 395 億元，其中生產設備資本支出約占 95%，大部分用
於高雄產能及製程提升，少部分用於台中廠製程提升，高雄廠產
能將由現在 15k 擴充至年底的 24k，屆時位元出貨量可望翻倍，同
時啟動高雄 Module B 投資計劃，規劃月產能可達 50k~ 60k，將分
階段擴充，預估 2027 年 1 月動工，2029 年 1 月裝機，2029 年底量
產。2027 年預估 DRAM 、NOR Flash 及 SLC NAND 價格持續上漲帶
動營收獲利成長，預估 2027 年營收 4077.20 億(YoY+58.12%)，毛
利率 74.52%，稅後淨利 1960.56 億(YoY+84.02%)，EPS 43.57 元。

4. CUBE 及矽電容為新成長動能 
AI 時代來臨，華邦電長期專注於利基型 DRAM ，針對 AI 將主攻邊
緣運算市場，邊緣運算之記憶體容量不需像 AI Server 那麼高，為
華邦電可著墨之區塊，因此華邦電提供 CUBE(Customized Ultra 
Bandwidth Element 客製化超高頻寬記憶體元件)解決方案，CUBE
具備超低功耗和超高性能、小尺寸、高成本效益，從而大幅提升
系統能力、回應時間和能源效率，以滿足邊緣運算平臺上快速增
長的 AI 應用需求。CUBE 優點在於 1)SoC 推疊在上面，散熱效果
較好、2) 可在 CUBE Die 上做穿孔(TSV)，降低成本、3) 3D 推疊
適合較小的終端裝置。目前華邦電與多家客戶開發 CUBE 方案，
預估 2026 年底開始貢獻，2027 年放量。另外因應 AI 晶片功耗劇
增、瞬間電流波動，以及先進封裝的空間限制，矽電容具有極低
的等效串聯電感與寄生電感，能在極短時間內補償電流，維持電
源完整性，避免電壓驟降，也彌補傳統 MLCC 的不足，華邦電因
客戶需求提供矽電容 foundry 代工，目前產能已滿載，未來 CUBE
及矽電容均為新成長動能。

營 運 分 析

台光電為全球銅箔基板龍頭廠  
台光電成立於 1992 年並於 1998 年市，總部位於桃園觀音，為全球最大無鹵
素銅箔基板供應商，AI Server 中 CCL 市占率超過 50%，同時是 HDI 材料
龍頭 。主力產品為銅箔基板 (CCL)、黏合片 (PP)及多層壓合板 (Mass 
Lamination)，不過自 2020 年起切入 IC載板材料(BT/ABF)之 CCL以作為第
二成長曲線，目前正積極推進客戶認證與產能擴充。

圖一、台光電為全球 CCL與 HDI 材料龍頭廠商

資料來源：公司；兆豐投顧整理

生產基地包含台灣桃園觀音、新竹，中國江蘇昆山、廣東中山、湖北黃石，
以及馬來西亞檳城。銅箔基板月產能現況約 585 萬張，預計 2026 年底增至
約 615 萬張，2027 年底目標達 930 萬張。26Q2以基礎設施應用(AI伺服器、
Switch、低軌衛星等)為主，占比約 80%。

圖二、台光電全球布局與產能龜卦

資料來源：公司；兆豐投顧整理

AI 趨勢帶動 CCL缺料漲價，26Q2營收獲利雙創新高，EPS 27.6元 
台光電公告 26Q2 營收 472.8 億元，QoQ +43%/YoY +110%，創單季新高，
優於財測，係因產品全線分批調漲以反映原物料成本上漲之影響，同時高階
產品 M7/M8 佔比持續提升所致，在產品結構改善與漲價效益帶動下，毛利率
跳升至 33.9%，季增 4.5ppt，稅後淨利 98.7 億元， QoQ +84.9%/YoY 
+183.9%，EPS 27.6元。

26Q3 高階材料占比續升、漲價效應完整反映，EPS 33.5 元 
兆豐投顧預估台光電 26Q3 營收 544.6 億元，QoQ +15.2%/YoY +116.6%，
延續強勁成長動能，主要受惠 Q3 全面採用新報價，同時在 ASIC 客戶與新
一代 GPU推出下帶動更高階 M8/M9 材料出貨佔比增加，同時在低軌衛星重
啟拉貨下將持續推升營運動能，受惠整體產品組合持續優化，預估毛利率提
升至 35%，季增 1.1ppt，稅後淨利 120 億元，QoQ +21.5%/YoY +202.5%，
EPS 33.5元。

高階材料放量、稼動率維持滿載，2026年 EPS 113.2 元 
展望 2026 年，隨著AI Server、高速交換器與 General server 需求持續強勁，
公司持續擴產以滿足市場需求，月產能預計 2026 年底增至約 615 萬張，年
增約 5%，此外由於 AI Server 規格持續提升，高階材料佔比將逐步墊高，同
時 BT 材料已開始認證，預期 Q4 開始放量出貨；原物料方面，研究部認為
高階 CCL缺料格局將延續，而公司亦持續分階段調漲報價因應原物料成本上
升，在整體產品組合轉佳與漲價效應帶動下，預期毛利率將逐季攀升。綜上
所述，兆豐投顧預估台光電 2026 年營收 1,941.7 億元，YoY +106%，毛利
率 33.9%，年增 4.1pt，稅後淨利 405.4 億元，YoY +176.8%，EPS 113.2
元。

Aspeed Technology
Valuation
We value Aspeed at NT$20,455 based on a historical mid-cycle multiple (since 2020) of 50x 2028E EPS, as we believe it fairly
reflects the company’s earnings performance and industry dynamics, secular growth trends, and Aspeed’s strong supply chain
position, as well as robust earnings growth amid margin expansions.
Risks
Our quant rating system rates the Aspeed stock High Risk based on its volatility over the past year, which we think is

unwarranted given the company's dominance and outlook in the BMC sector. Key downside risks to our earnings forecasts and
target price include: 1) weaker-than-expected growth in servers; 2) slower-than-expected CPU platform migration; 3) peer
competition; and 4) limited progress in product diversification.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

upgrade our rating on Global Unichip (GUC) by 2 notches to Buy (1), 
thanks to: 1) more capacity unleashed from its key foundry to meet more 
demand for higher top-line; and 2) more frugal opex control to help offset 
the extra demand, which is AI-centric and volume-accretive but gross 
margin (GM) dilutive. Our forecast hikes, together with the recent share 
price correction on equity market’s hefty expectation reset for “silicon 
inflation”, in our view, offer an attractive opportunity for bargain hunting.

What’s the impact: Forecast revisions. We raise our 2026-28E EPS by 
9-19% for GUC to factor in mixed business drivers. On the positive front, 
revenue run rate appears to be running across its Turnkey (ie. mass-
production) and NRE businesses, thanks to customers’ active datacentre 
buildout driven by migration from generative to agentic AI. Based on our 
market research, for the Turnkey business, we now forecast revenue to 
more than double YoY this year to TWD54bn for 85% contribution, driven 
by extra capacity unleashed by its key foundry partner, helping GUC meet 
more customer demand across AI CPU and accelerators, current and next 
generations. For NRE, albeit some rebalancing in 3Q26 following a strong 
uptick a quarter ago, we expect revenue to recover in 4Q26 for meaningful 
ramps into 2027, driven by new AI projects and AI automotive ship-outs.

Strong top-line and frugal opex … GUC’s AI projects are volume 
accretive but GM dilutive, since the higher value-add parts such as core 
dies are not done by GUC, which focuses on advanced packaging. That 
said, by leveraging its integrated “ADS+APT” model (advanced design 
service, advanced packaging tech), with strategic capacity support from its 
key foundry, we see scope for GUC to move up the GM vertical.

… helping mitigate lower GM. Another positive factor is, since GUC does 
not need to commit much R&D relative to projects prior to AI, opex should 
remain well controlled. While we forecast its GM trajectory to shift into the 
low 20s over our forecast period (vs. c.30% on average in the past decade 
before the AI ramp), we expect its operating margin to improve to 14-15% 
over our forecast period (vs. 7-15% on an annual basis over 2016-25).

What we recommend: We raise our 12M TP to TWD5,125 (previous: 
TWD4,525), based on a new 4-quarter forward PER of 63x (previous: 75x), 
justified by 2025-28E EPS CAGR of 60%. We hike our rating 2 notches to 
Buy (1), with downside risk of less foundry support and margin execution.

How we differ: Our 2026E EPS is 12% above consensus, likely on our 
higher AI CPU and accelerator business assumptions.

5 August 2026

Upgrading: unleashed capacity adding to growth

➢ Raise our forecasts on increased capacity support and frugal opex 
➢ AI projects are gross-margin dilutive but scale accretive 
➢ Upgrade rating to Buy (1), with a higher 12M TP of TWD5,125

Q given higher substrate and OSAT prices.

partnership in Aspeed's next-gen products such as AST2800.

Earnings upward revisions; lift TP NT$365 on attractive valuation; Buy— We lift
our 2026/27 /28E earnings by 9%/4%/9% to factor in more AI ASIC ramp from 4Q26
onward and auto/industrial recovery. We raise our DCF-based TP to NT$365
(implied 11x 2027E EPS) from NT$350 (implied 10x 2027E EPS). We believe 11x
multiple isn’t stretched and justified by semiconductor upcycle. Reiterate our Buy
rating.

WT Micro (3036.TW)
06 August 2026 Citi Research
6
WT Micro
Company description
Founded in 1993, WT Micro focuses on semiconductor-related component
agency sales. Currently, it ranks among the top four IC distributors globally
and holds a market share of around 12%. Headquartered in Taiwan, WT Micro
has an extensive marketing and sales channel with nearly 50 regional offices
across China, Korea, Singapore, India, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam. WT

Micro currently serves as the distribution partner to >25,000 customers for
over 80 global leading semiconductor partners. As of 2023, 28% revenues
came from mobile phone, 22% from datacenter, 14% from communication,
10% from industrial, 10% from PC, 9% from consumer and 8% from
automotive application
Investment strategy
We rate WT Micro as Buy. From a top-down view, we expect the IC
distribution industry to be aided by semi upcycle on AI in 2026. We also see

global supply chain relocation favoring WT Micro going forward given its more
diversified global footprints. For its subsidiary, Future Electronics, which WT
Micro acquired in 2024, we are seeing the merger bearing fruit given ongoing
recovery in auto/industrial business for US/European customers with higher
GM profile. Furthermore, we believe there is significant further potential from
synergies, primarily through cross-selling to each company's customer base

and securing new distribution rights in the U.S. and Europe.
Valuation
We use DCF methodology to derive our target price of NT$365. Key
assumptions of our DCF model include a risk-free rate of 4.1% (10-year
government bond rate), a market risk premium of 7%, and an equity beta of
0.9 (1-year weekly share price), which derives a WACC of 8.6%. Our model
assumes 1% long-term revenue growth and gradual expanding of EBIT margin
from 1.9% in 2028 to 2.3% in the long term. Our target price is equivalent to

13x/11x 2026/27E EPS and 3.3x/2.5x BVPS, which is in line with its peers'
valuation and we believe is justified by AI trend, upsides from its subsidiary,
Future Electronics.
Risks
Key downside risks that could prevent WT Micro’s share price from reaching
our target price are: 1) weaker-than-expected end market demand; 2) lower-
than-expected synergy from the acquisition of Future; 3) taking longer time to
acquire new distribution rights or 4) aggressive funding for its working capital

via higher leverage ratio (more interest expense) or GDR issuance (earnings
dilution).

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and

### Page 1

Summary: Innodisk released its 2Q26 results and monthly revenue for July 2026, on 6 
August 2026 after market hours. The EPS was TWD108.93, beating our and the 
Bloomberg consensus estimates by 65.3% and 24.5%, respectively, which we attribute to 
memory price hikes and product mix improvement. We see an incrementally positive tone 
from the company on its order outlook for 2H26 due to favourable memory price hikes and 
rising AI application.

We have a Buy (1) rating on the stock with a 12-month TP of TWD2,385, based on a target 
PER of 10x, applied to our 1-year-forward EPS. For more information on this company, 
please refer to our flash, Record-high monthly revenue driven by flash price hike, beating 
expectations, on 6 July 2026.

What’s the impact 
• 2Q26 results: a strong beat. Innodisk posted 2Q26 revenue of TW22,443m (+70.3% 
QoQ and +641.1% YoY), a record-high level, beating our and the Bloomberg consensus 
estimates by 53.0% and 16.5%, respectively. Gross margin came in at 65.0%, also a 
record-high level (higher than 59.1% in 1Q26 and 25.9% in 2Q25), above our estimate 
(60.0%) and the consensus (61.9%), thanks to memory price hikes. Thus, its operating 
profit of TWD13,146m (+91.9% QoQ and +3,615.5% YoY) beat our and the consensus 
estimates by 67.8% and 21.6%, respectively. Its net profit of TWD10,368m (+89.7% 
QoQ and +5,493.8% YoY) beat our and the Bloomberg consensus estimates by 65.5% 
and 22.9%, respectively. Innodisk’s 2Q26 basic EPS came in at TWD108.93. Note 
Innodisk’s product mix for 2Q26 was Flash: 35%; DRAM: 60%.

• Record-high July revenue ahead of estimates. Innodisk reported record-high monthly 
sales for July of TWD8,495m (+3.5% MoM and +636.5% YoY; +548.8% for 7M26), 
which accounted for 57.8% and 38.8%, respectively, of our (TWD14,700m, +0.2% QoQ 
and +286.1% YoY) and the Bloomberg consensus forecasts of 3Q26 revenue. The 
company expects its August and September revenue to grow MoM.

• Much stronger demand over supply. Innodisk expects its revenue momentum to 
continue into 2H26. Due to the strong visibility, the company is currently selective with 
orders and is focusing on value creation across applications, clients and products. For 
3Q26, the company expects its revenue to grow QoQ, with gross margin sustainable at 
the 2Q26 level.

What we recommend 
We reaffirm our Buy (1) rating with a 12-month target price of TWD2,385, based on our 
target PER of 10x, applied to our 1-year forward EPS. Based on our 2026/27 EPS 
estimates, the stock is currently trading at PERs of 6.8x/6.6x, vs. its past-3-year trading 
range of 1-24x (average: 10x). Key risks: weaker-than-expected memory price hikes and 
slower-than-expected progress in high-gross margin orders.

Document 110: 260806_daiwa_novatek

Source PDF: all report pdf/260806_daiwa_novatek.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-08-06
Pages: 7
Status: ok

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: Novatek disclosed upbeat 2Q26 results and 3Q26 guidance 
thanks to continued supply-chain cost pass-through, as well as share gain 
in the high-end smartphone OLED display driver (D/D) market. Though we 
raise forecasts and TP to reflect these unusual business dynamics amid 
the “silicon inflation”, we remain comfortable with our Hold (3) rating. That 
said, we are structurally positive on its leading position in design and 
technology for SoC diversification to cope with the D/D competition.

What’s the impact: Results and guidance all beat yet ... Novatek 
reported 2Q26 EPS of TWD10.4, beating our/consensus estimates by 
31%/36% thanks to robust gross margin (GM) that beat guidance (38-41%) 
and market expectation on supply-chain cost pass-through, favourable SoC 
mix and low-cost inventory, as well as frugal opex control and higher non-
operating gains associated with investment and dividend incomes (table on 
p.2). Guidance calls for 3Q26 revenue to still grow 5-9% QoQ regardless of 
a demand slowdown in the consumer space. Yet guided GM of 38.5-41.5% 
implies a QoQ drop due to no more low-cost inventory and an unfavourable 
mix as small-and-medium D/D will drive the growth, while SoC revenue will 
be flat and large D/D will drop QoQ, per management.

… business dynamics don’t seem to be structural. While our view 
calling for a demand rebalancing across TV and PC in the consumer space 
after customers’ order pull-in in 1H26 appears to be materialising, per 
management’s comments at today’s call, Novatek’s share gain in the high-
end smartphone OLED D/D market looks to be helping it offset the impact, 
with extra delta to be contributed by the continued pass-through of wafer 
and OSAT cost hikes through the supply chain. We therefore lift our 2026-
28E EPS by 2-21% but view these dynamics as unusual amid the “silicon 
inflation” environment. That said, we remain structurally positive on 
Novatek’s leading position in design capability and process technology for 
diversification into a broadened SoC portfolio to cope with any intense D/D 
competition, including machine-vision solutions for applications from 
surveillance to drones, smart wearables, smart appliances to robotics.

What we recommend: Given our forecast revisions, we raise our 12M TP 
for Novatek to TWD515 (previous: TWD430), still based on our 4-quarter 
forward PER target of 13x. We reaffirm our Hold (3) rating with key 
upside/downside risks of any further cost pass-through/deteriorated end-
demand on commodity price hikes.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 20-24% above the consensus, as 
we believe the street has yet to factor in the full effect of the cost pass-
through.

6 August 2026

Rebalancing still yet resilience on share gain

➢ 2Q26 results and 3Q26 guidance all upbeat  
➢ Consumer rebalancing offset by high-end smartphone share gain 
➢ Reiterating Hold (3) rating with a higher 12M TP of TWD515

2Q26 result overview 
NYPCB 2Q26 core business (OPI) was 15% higher than BBG 
consensus, but was 8% lower than our estimate (most bullish on the 
street). GM went up by 8.9ppt QoQ, the highest growth among all 
Taiwan ABF players (Unimicron/Kinsus’ GM went up by 
+6.8ppt/+4.9ppt QoQ only in 2Q26), which is in-line with our more 
bullish view on spot price ABF substrates players’ profitability 
expansion speed vs. LTA players. For earnings, NYPCB’s 2Q EPS was 
5% higher than the BBG consensus but was 18% lower than GSe.  
3Q26 outlook - UTR in Kunshan start ramping up despite low yield 
rate, while ABF/BT pricing hike will continue to drive GM/OPM 
For 3Q26, we expect NYPCB’s revenue will go up by 27% QoQ in 
3Q26, while the key update is the company’s Kunshan plant 
(~15-20% of overall ABF substrate capacity) utilization rate reached 
70% in July (vs. 50% in 2Q26; which drove July revenue went up by 
16% MoM), with key high end customers starting to place orders in 
mainland China (which is in-line with our view that all the ABF 
substrates capacity will be working under fully utilized level from 
2H26, due to the severe shortage condition of ~15-20% shortage 
ratio; see here). 
However, our understanding is that the company’s Kunshan plant 
was built for mid to low end ABF substrates, and the increasing 
production on high-end ABF substrate in Kunshan plant could lead 
to an unfavorable GM for overall ABF substrates business in the near 
term (3Q26), but we do expect this will be offset by the increasing 
spot price from August/September, and we also believe the yield 
rate will eventually improve and lead to an even higher than 
company’s average GM in coming months/quarters. As a result, we 
expect NYPCB’s 3Q GM will further jump by 6.6ppt QoQ to 
31.3%, whose GM could surpass Kinsus/Unimicron and become 
the highest among all Taiwan ABF suppliers (we expect

### Page 3

Kinsus/Unimicron GM will reach 28.4%/27.4% in 3Q).  
Investment thesis - GM to surpass TW peers from 2H26; new CAPEX on high end ABF 
substrates suggesting more upside on ASP in LT 
As discussed several times (see here), we believe NYPCB will start outgrowing players on 
the margin side from 2H26, when the ABF substrate market enters a real supply 
shortage stage, and we saw NYPCB’s GM approaching Kinsus/Unimicron’s in 2Q26, who 
should start delivering a stronger GM from 2H26, as we discussed, due mainly to the 
company’s proactive strategy on pricing (focus on spot price market should make the 
company deliver a better GM/OPM outlook than LTA peers during the shortage period). 
Considering our positive view on the ABF substrate demand and the long capacity 
expansion lead time of the industry, we believe the ABF substrate capacity shortage 
period will last for 30+ months, implying NYPCB’s outperformance on GM/OPM growth 
vs. other TW ABF names should not be just a short-term condition.  
Moreover, the company announced a new CAPEX plan (here), while the company will 
invest in NT$46.8bn (vs. the company’s overall CAPEX in 2025 was only at NT$2.4bn vs. 
peak annual CAPEX in last upcycle was NT$16.9bn only) on a new high-end ABF 
substrate plant in Chiayi. Based on our estimate, the new capacity will be used to 
produce TSMC next generation CoPoS packaging substrates, and the capacity could 
come on stream right after TSMC start mass producing CoPoS packaging technology in 
2H28-1H29 (the capacity expansion lead time is also in-line with our view of 30+ 
months). We do believe the company’s proactive investment in the next generation 
packaging technology should lead the company’s overall ASP to another level, while we 
believe the substrate size / layer count could be 100%/ 30%+ larger/higher than the 
company’s most high end products now, suggesting a long term revenue/earnings 
outlook after 2028.  
Overall, considering the near term profitability outperformance and the positive 
long term revenue/earning outlook with the new high-end capacity expansion, we 
maintain our Buy rating (on CL) on NYPCB with new TP of NT$2,500 (from 
NT$2,310).

Earnings revision 
We revise up our 2027/28/29E earnings estimate by 2/9/23% to factor in the more

We slightly revise down the 2026 revenue estimate by 2% (due to the less favorable than

Valuation 
We are Buy rated on NYPCB, with a new TP of NT$2,500 (from NT$2,310), based on an 
unchanged 21x 2028E EPS (+1.5x STDV above the past upcycle average P/E of 13.3x as 
we expect a better pricing outlook in spot price market this time vs. last upcycle in 
2020-2022), considering the much better customer mix and the much better demand 
visibility.

Investment Thesis & PT methodology and risks

Investment Thesis - NYPCB 
NYPCB manufactures and markets printed circuit boards (PCBs) and integrated circuit 
(IC) substrates (including ABF and BT substrates). We are Buy-rated on NYPCB 
considering the company’s high exposure to BT substrates and non-LTA ABF substrate

(70%+ of total revenue), where we expect GM/OPM to increase significantly in the
coming quarters (from breakeven in OPM in 1H25 to 27/41% in 2026/27E) due to the
favorable substrate pricing outlook. Despite the company’s low exposure to high-end
ABF substrate industry (<20% of total revenue in 1H25), we believe the expanding
demand from ASIC AI server and high-end switch IC demand will drive the company’s
high-end ABF revenue exposure to 40%+ by 2027E, suggesting better GM/OPM outlook

in the long term. In 2H25-2H26, we believe NYPCB will continue to benefit from stronger
ABF/BT pricing and should be a key beneficiary of the pricing uptrend considering the
company’s key focus on BT and non-LTA ABF substrate industries. Moreover, in the long
term (after 2026), we expect the ABF industry to return to supply tightness, and NYPCB’s
expanding high-end exposure will lead to a long term earnings growth outlook (122%
2026-28E earnings CAGR). As a result, we see solid upside potential for NYPCB’s

earnings and stock performance.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - NYPCB
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$2,500 for NYPCB is based
on 21x 2028E P/E, which is +1.5x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E (13.3x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, and (3)
Slower-than-expected NYPCB new high-end capacity qualification progress.

WinWay reported its 2Q26 preliminary results (see Exhibit 1) on 6 
Aug. 2Q26 GM was down by 4.7ppts QoQ to 38.3% in 2Q26, below 
cons. of 42.7% but inline with our expectation of 38.6% (see our 
preview). The company also reported its July revenue, which came in 
much stronger than GSe. On the back of the ongoing capacity 
expansion and the robust demand especially from US customers 
following new project ramps in 2H26, we now expect further 
strength in revenue growth momentum of 56% HoH (vs. 35% 
previously) into 2H26E.  
We continue to see WinWay as a key beneficiary under AI mega 
trend with solid customer profile (AI GPU/server CPU/AI ASIC 
customers accounting for 80%+ of total revenue) and strong TAM 
expansion for testing interface industry. WinWay’s share price fell 
32% (vs Taiex -5%) over the past one month, which we believe likely 
reflects concern over near term GM weakness. The shares now 
trade at c.31x/16x FY27/28E (vs. avg. of 50x/40x over the past 1 
year/since the AI boom starting 2024), with earnings CAGR 
expected to further accelerate to 108% over the 2025-28E 
period (vs. 86% in 2023-25), we thus see risk reward further skewed 
to the upside. We revise up our 2027/28E EPS by 11-14%, and raise 
our 12m TP to NT$14,800 (40x 2028E discounted P/E) from 
NT$13,000, with 118.5% implied upside, and reiterate our Buy 
rating. 
2Q26 GM inline with GSe but miss cons. 
2Q26 GM of 38.3% (down 468bps QoQ) came in largely inline with 
GSe, yet below cons. of 42.7%, which we attribute to incremental 
upfront cost/depreciation from capacity expansion, higher revenue 
contribution from lower-GM MEMS probe card, and cost inflation 
across the supply chain. 2Q26 opex ratio of 14.9% was inline with 
GSe but below cons. of 15.9%, thanks to better cost control and 
stronger operating leverage. Overall, WinWay’s 2Q26 EPS of

Set for accelerating revenue momentum into 3Q26
Looking ahead, WinWay’s stronger-than-expected July revenue reinforces our
expectation of continued strong growth into 3Q26. July revenue reached NT$1,600mn,
accounting for c.38% of our prior 3Q26E revenue forecast of NT$4,262mn. We thus
revised up our 3Q26E revenue forecast and now model 3Q26E revenue to grow by
36.9% QoQ (vs. 21.0% QoQ previously). We believe this strong sequential growth will

mainly be driven by the ramp-up of new projects for WinWay’s US customers for AI GPU,
server CPU and AI ASIC.
On margin front, however, we expect the incremental upfront costs/depreciation
associated with capacity expansion to persist in the near term, together with continued
strength in lower-GM MEMS probe cards, weighing on GM in 3Q26. Overall, we now
expect GM to remain largely flat QoQ at 38.8% (vs. 39.3% previously).
Multiple structural growth drivers to support a robust earnings CAGR into 2028

We believe WinWay’s growth will continue to surpass management’s baseline guidance
of 50-60% TAM expansion into 2028, driven by 1) stronger server CPU test socket
demand driven by agentic AI; 2) ongoing share gains in the AI GPU SLT market following
its penetration into its US AI GPU customer’s SLT market beyond the FT market; 3)
content value growth across generations, with pin counts already rising at least 30% for
one of its key AI GPU customers and potentially doubling for another AI ASIC project;

and 4) accelerating HyperSocket adoption, with over 50% of new customer programs
expected to adopt the new architecture and benefit from 20-30% higher ASPs vs.
coaxial sockets.
To meet this robust demand, we believe WinWay is on track to expand its capacity
aggressively, with management targeting an increase in socket pin capacity from
3.5mn pins per month at end-2025 to 9mn by end-2026, and further to 14mn pins
by 1H27—representing 157% YoY capacity growth in 2026E, followed by another 56%

increase into 1H27. Overall, we expect WinWay to enjoy robust multi-year growth, with
revenue projected to grow 112.2%/95.2%/69.9% YoY in 2026-28E (vs.
94.6%/74.3%/65.6% YoY previously).

### Page 5

Earnings changes, valuation and risks 
Forecast changes 
We incorporate the 2Q26 preliminary results into our model and revise up our 
2026/2027/2028E EPS by 2.9%/11.4%/13.8% mainly as we factor in 1) WinWay’s 
stronger-than-expected July revenue 2) ongoing capacity expansion, and 3) robust 
demand especially from US customers following new project ramps in 2H26.

Maintain Buy with TP raised to NT$14,800 from NT$13,000 
As a result of our upward earnings revisions, we raise our 12-month TP to NT$14,800 
(from NT$13,000 previously). Our 12-month TP is still based on 40x 2028E discounted 
P/E. We apply this to our 2028E EPS, and discount it back to 2027E at a 13.6% CoE to 
arrive at our TP . Our key assumptions for CoE include: (1) 1.5x beta (sourcing 
Bloomberg), (2) a 4.25% risk-free rate (inline with GS house-view), and (3) a market risk 
premium of 6.25% (in line with our GS house view). Overall, our new TP implies c.118.5% 
upside from the current share price, and we maintain our Buy rating on WinWay.

M
Idea
Remain OW and move to Top Pick:  We remain confident in S-SiCap, which is in
structural supply shortage (link), and VHM opportunities helped by edge AI (link).
Our new price target implies 2027e P/E of 47x and 2028e P/E of 26x; the 2028e P/
E    is roughly in line with the historical average since 2020.
2Q26 earnings beat: See Results recap                 .
Business update and outlook:
•  IoTRAM: 2Q revenue was NT$1.69bn, helped by stronger demand from

display customers. Management expects strong demand momentum, as
some customers shift from commodity memory to IoTRAM due to elevated
pricing. IoTRAM pricing was also increased in view of rising costs.
• S-SiCap: 2Q revenue was NT$640mn, as multiple cases have entered mass
production. IPD is entering an unprecedented rapid mass production ramp
supporting new embedded-in-substrate application for AI/HPC, with demand
visibility into 2028.  IPC production is set to resume in 4Q after potential

disruption in 3Q from the sale of PSMC's Tongluo fab. LSC has also entered
stable mass production. S-SiCap's revenue may exceed IoTRAM's in 2027.
• VHM: 2Q revenue was NT$37mn, mainly NRE. VHM is expected to enter
mass production in 2028. The first 8-high VHM is going through
qualification, with mass production expected around the end of 2027/ early
2028.
Other takeaways: AP Memory has entered  long-term capacity agreements with
major foundry and OSAT partners to secure wafer supply and OSAT capacity, and

expects to pay  deposits or prepayments to the partners. A GDR issuance has been
proposed, of up to 15mn shares (no more than 8.43% dilution),  for working capital
needs as the company sees strong growth opportunities.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Macronix International Co Ltd (2337.TW)
Base case, P/B, in line with our Greater China memory coverage, due to the memory industry's
cyclical nature. We apply a target multiple of 7.0x to our 2026 BVPS estimate, vs. its historical
average of 1.5x since 2017. We continue to believe the P/B target is justifiable, as The MLC and
legacy TLC NAND could be in greater shortage into 2H26, with under supply easily going up

to 40%. The only supplier which could fill the gap remains Macronix.
Risks to Upside
n Wider legacy NAND supply / demand gap
n NOR up-cycle, driven by limited supply expansion and/or stronger demand
n Faster growth for Switch hardware and core titles
Risks to Downside
n Less severe legacy NAND supply / demand gap
n NOR down-cycle, driven by faster supply expansion and/or demand weakness
n Slower growth for Switch hardware and core titles

### Page 1

M
Update
Chenbro  | Asia Pacific
2Q26 Slightly Better  on Margin;
3Q26 Revenue Momentum
Needs Monitoring
Despite the GM holding up better, July monthly sales pointed to
potential risks to the 3Q26 growth outlook, in our view.
What's new:
• Off revenue of NT$7,821mn (+10% QoQ/+44% YoY), GM dropped 0.2ppts
QoQ, to 32.6%, likely on a less favorable product mix and lower NRE income,
though this is above MSe at 31.6% and consensus at 31.4%.
• Opex was NT$638mn (opex ratio of 8.2%), vs. MSe of NT$602mn (opex ratio

7.9%) and consensus of NT$607mn (opex ratio 7.7%), leading to operating
profit of NT$1,926mn (OPM 24.6%), 7%/3% higher than MSe at NT$1,807mn
(OPM 23.8%)/consensus at NT$1,870mn (OPM 23.7%).
• With the non-op loss of NT$22mn, net profit of NT$1,383mn (EPS NT$11.29)
was 4% higher than MSe at NT$1,330mn (EPS NT$10.86) but 2% short of
consensus at NT$1,411mn (EPS NT$11.23).
• July revenue were NT$2,462mn (-24% MoM/+42% YoY).  QTD sales reached
28% of our 3Q26 estimate at NT$8,659mn (+11% QoQ/+53% YoY) and 26%

of consensus at NT$9,364mn (+20% QoQ/+65% YoY).
Our view:
• We see 3Q26 revenue tracking behind expectations.
• Chenbro should continue to  grow along with server shipments and its own
share gains, as well as the rack offerings, though growth momentum in the
near term needs monitoring.
• 2Q26 earnings call at 2pm HKT on Aug 7th.

Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

King Slide Works Co. Ltd.  | Asia Pacific
2Q26 Beat on 87% GM;
Momentum Sustaining Into
2H26
Another set of solid results to reassure the market about its
earnings sustainability, entrenched by its dominant industry
position. Stay OW.
2Q26  GM strong beat:
• Off revenue of NT$10,830mn (+99% QoQ/+156% YoY),  GM expanded 9.7ppt
QoQ to 87.4%  (vs. MSe/consensus at 78.1%/74.7%), which we think was
mainly driven by a more favorable product mix.

• Opex was NT$578mn (opex ratio 5.3%), lower than our estimate of NT
$707mn (opex ratio 6.5%) and  consensus of NT$494mn (opex ratio 5.5%)
• Operating profit came in at NT$8,890mn (+143% QoQ/+200% YoY; OPM
+15ppt QoQ to 82.1%), 15% higher than MSe of NT$7,751mn (OPM 71.6%) and
43% higher than consensus of NT$6,208mn (OPM 69.2%).
• With non-op gains of NT$229mn, including FX loss of NT$58mn, net profit
was NT$7,088mn (EPS NT$74.38), 14%/42% above MSe/consensus  at NT

$6,216mn (EPS NT$65.22)/NT$4,981mn (EPS NT$53.59).
• July revenue  was NT$6,407mn (+44% MoM/+356% YoY). QTD revenue
reached 52% of MSe at NT$12,232mn (+13% QoQ/+180% YoY) and 68% of
consensus at NT$9,427mn (-13% QoQ/+116% YoY).
Our view:
• Once again, King Slide has demonstrated earnings growth sustainability,
supported by its dominant industry position, against concerns over its
market share and profitability. We think this could enhance the market

conviction on its growth outlook ahead.
• While the 87.4% GM in 2Q26 was phenomenal, we would like to reiterate
that King Slide's earnings growth looks more driven by revenue growth than
margin expansion.
• Looking into 2H26, we think the strong July monthly sales indicate
momentum should sustain to drive another quarter of impressive sequential
growth on the top line vs. recent market expectations of 20-30% QoQ.
• 2Q26 earnings call at 2pm HKT on Aug 7th.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
King Slide Works Co. Ltd. (2059.TW)
Base case, 30x 2027e P/E. We use price/earnings as our valuation methodology because we
believe it better captures King Slide's earnings growth potential. We believe our target mul-
tiple is justified by an operating profit CAGR of 56% seen for 2025-28, implying a PEG of 0.5
vs. the average of 1.2 over 2010-24, when the stock was trading at 17-18x P/E with an operating

profit CAGR of 14%.
Risks to Upside
n Stronger-than-expected AI capex
n Stronger server demand
n Faster market share gains
Risks to Downside
n Softer AI capex
n Weaker server demand
n Sluggish kitchen furniture demand
n Competition leading to slower share gains.

### Page 1

ab 6 August 2026
Global Research
First Read
Accton Technology Corporation
Trianium 3 and 800G  ramp driving H226 growth
Q226 ahead on better sales
Accton reported Q226 EPS of NT$19.78, ahead of UBS/Consensus estimates on stronger
topline growth and better margins. Q226 sales of NT$95.5bn was up 36% QoQ, ahead
of its original guidance of ~20% QoQ primarily driven by stronger pull in for 800G cloud
switch for its new social media customer and  faster ramp of Trainium 3 AI card. Q226

GM of 19.7% was up 0.2ppts QoQ on better product mix  and greater revenue scale,
resulting in OPM of 15.0% (+0.7ppts QoQ) on operating leverage (OPEX  grew 23%
QoQ including bonus accrual). We estimate data center switch accounted for 36% of
Q226 sales (vs 31% Q126), while accelerator card was 50% of total sales (53% Q126).
Q326 sales should continue to expand, despite component supply constraint
Accton expects Q326 sales to   improve QoQ with July sales reported at flattish MoM,

suggesting  25%+ QoQ growth,  above UBSe/consensus expectations. Management
noted the robust sale momentum  is supported by the continued ramp of Trainium 3 and
800G cloud switch deployment by its major customer and new social media customer.
Nevertheless, Accton noted it continued to see component supply constraint (ASIC IC,
PCB, MLCC, memory, etc.), which is capping its  near-term order fulfilment. We forecast
Accton's Q326 sales to grow 30% QoQ, while GM may arrive at 19.4% (-0.3ppt QoQ)

on mix change (AI card has lower GM), leading to OPM of 15.2% (+0.2ppt QoQ).
Increase value-add and new project ramps supporting 2027E momentum
We see multiple drivers supporting Accton to further increase its value-adds into 2027E,
on top of better shipments for AI cards and cloud switch businesses. We expect its ASP
for Trainium 3 to further increase from Q426-2027E, driven by the adoption of liquid
cooling in selective designs. We believe Accton's content in Trainium 4 (pilot in Q427)

should further increase on more complicated board design, further adoption of liquid
cooling, and potential CPO/NPO adoption. For the cloud switch business, we believe it is
working with its social media customer for ramping Nvidia's Spectrum 6 switch and
could potentially start to see revenue contribution from 2027E, while the ongoing speed
migration (800G/1.6T), supplying of switch trays, and introduction of OCS (Optical
Circuit Switch) will further increase Accton's content value. We also expect L11 server

rack  to see more meaningful sales contribution in 2027, versus minimal 2026.
Valuation: Reiterate Buy with NT$3,688 PT
We raise our 2026-28E EPS by +10%/2%/4% on stronger sales outlook for AI card /
cloud switch and better margins. We retain Buy rating and NT$3,688 PT, based on 26x
average 2027-28E PE (from 27x) on market valuation contraction, still in the upper half
of its historical 10-31x range and supported by a 52% EPS CAGR in 2025-28E. Stock has

pulled back 14% from recent peak and is trading at 20.7x 2027E PE. We believe the
stock should further re-rate on accelerating EPS growth from H226, Nvidia  CPO switch
ramp for new customer, and  potential opportunities in OCS.

Company Description
Founded in 1988, Accton specialises in ODM/OEM solutions for data center switches, AI
accelerator cards, enterprise/ODM switches, carrier access/telecom and others. Accton is one
of the largest vendors of white-box and OCP-compliant switches globally (by sales).
Leveraging deep expertise in high-speed switching, system integration and rapid time-to-

market, it has secured long-term partnerships with major cloud service providers.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value Accton using PE methodology.
Key risks include: 1) weaker-than-expected demand for data center switches; 2) slower ramp
of 800G and 1.6T data center switches; 3) market share loss in the AI accelerator card
business; and 4) softer gross margin than expected.

### Page 2

2Q26 results review: Revenues were pre-announced, and in line with our estimates. GM 
was down to 0.2% reflecting the preparation for CPO FAU mass production, which 
carries high testing expenses with limited revenues. Nevertheless, we see the July 
revenue increase as signalling CPO related products entering mass production, and we 
expect revenues to increase sequentially going forward, driving GM recovery. Opex ratio 
of 21.7% was better than our expectation of 33.9%, reflecting the company’s disciplined 
cost control, supporting OP loss narrowing to NT$92m loss (vs. NT$156m loss in 1Q26), 
better than our estimates of NT$135m loss. Along with the higher-than-expected 
non-op income and lower-than-expected tax rate, the net income loss further narrowed 
to NT$25m loss (vs. NT$107m loss in 1Q26), better than our estimates of NT$101m loss.

Earnings revision: We factor in 2Q26 results and July revenues and reduce EPS by 3% / 
2% in 2026 / 27E, while keeping 2028-30E largely unchanged. The reduction is mainly 
on CPO FAU revenues and GM, reflecting the gradual ramp up since 3Q26, considering 
FOCI’s focus on high-end CPO FAU.

### Page 3

Valuation: We continue to derive target price via discounted PE and derive target PE 
multiple via peers’ trading PE vs. forward year EPS YoY (methodology unchanged with 
updated numbers). Our new target PE multiple slightly declined to 15.4x (vs. 15.9x 
previously) based on FOCI’s largely unchanged long term earnings growth (2030-31E 
EPS YoY at 15% on avg.), reflecting recent soft sector sentiment on AI server model 
transition. We continue to apply the target PE multiple to 2030E EPS (unchanged), and 
discounted back to 2027E via 12.6% COE (unchanged). Our new TP is NT$833 (vs. 
NT$864 previously). Our new TP implies 48x 2027E P/E or 0.4x 2028-29E EPS YoY. Our 
new TP implies 9x 2027E P/S, within its historical trading range of 5x to 30x. Maintain 
Buy.

correlation between forward-year trading P/E and earnings growth. 
Key downside risks: Fiercer-than-expected market competition, technology migration 
trends in optical networking, and slower-than-expected capacity ramp-up.

### Page 1

M
Idea
Is the revenue growth momentum sustainable? Yes:  King Slide posted solid
monthly sales of NT$6,407mn (+44% MoM/+356% YoY) in July. To put this into
perspective, this monthly run rate was 3.3x vs. that in March 2026 (NT$1,918mn,
+9% MoM/+39% YoY). Though management did not provide numerical guidance on
the call, it indicates that it is seeing broad-based strong customer demand  with good
order visibility across a wide range of applications in both data center and enterprise

environments. Because of its comprehensive patent portfolio and solid execution,
King Slide  should remain the go-to supplier in most relevant projects. Therefore, we
now expect revenue to  step up further in 3Q26, to NT$19,555mn (+81% QoQ/+348%
YoY).
What's the margin outlook? Confident: The 87.4% GM (+9.7ppt QoQ) for 2Q26
was remarkable. Management cited a more favorable product mix – it shipped
plenty of new products, which usually carry higher margins thanks to more

complicated design. Management believes that  rail kit technology will continue to
advance –  and King Slide is able to better address those needs through accumulated
knowledge to efficiently move  design concepts into manufacturable products.
Furthermore, the product life cycle has shortened to 6-12 months from 12-24
months in the past, which will pose more challenges for the supply chain – but at
the same time, position leading players like King Slide well to offer more  value. As a

result, management sounds confident about its margin outlook in coming years.
Does King Slide have enough capacity? It's coming: This is another natural
question for a company showing such robust growth in a short period. Management
indicated that it has been squeezing more output from its existing facilities through
equipment/automation upgrades and more work shifts; utilization is 70-80%  now.
Aside from existing plants, it will have US capacity coming online this September/

October and a new factory in Kaohsiung in 2H27. Last, it might kick off another
project in late 2026 in Kaohsiung next to its existing one that could accommodate a
greenfield factory – potentially tripling its existing capacity when fully operational.
Stay OW: We maintain the view that King Slide's competitiveness is well entrenched
and accentuated amid quick generation migration. The stock has rallied very
strongly, yet we believe the earnings outlook can sustain valuation.

Valuation Methodology
Our price target (base case scenario value) is NT$15,000 (previously NT$10,000):  It is
derived from our  target P/E of 30x 2027e (unchanged).
We use P/E as our valuation methodology because we believe it better captures King
Slide's earnings growth potential. We believe our 30x target P/E multiple is justified by an
operating profit CAGR of 77% for 2025-28 in our estimates, implying a PEG of 0.4 vs. the
average of 1.1 over 2010-25, when the stock traded at 18x P/E  with an operating profit

CAGR of 18%.
Bull case scenario value – NT$20,000 (vs. NT$13,000 previously): We apply a 40x
multiple to our base case estimate for 2027 (unchanged). Our bull case mainly reflects
stronger demand for server rail kits owing to heavy server capex and spec upgrades driven
by the secular AI trend.
Bear case scenario value – NT$7,500 (vs. NT$5,000 previously): We apply a 15x
multiple to our base case estimate for 2027 (unchanged). Our bear case mainly reflects

lukewarm data center demand amid softening IT capex budgets and pricing pressure for
server components without spec upgrades.

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

Analyst Industry Views

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Greater China Technology Hardware
Asia Pacific
Industry View In-Line
Our CY26 full-year forecast is now at 80-85K racks: This bakes in our recently
raised ~3.8K rack-equivalent forecast at Wistron (report here), to ~17.9K racks. This

year is a strong one for downstream rack assembly. We expect over 100% y/y
growth in rack shipments, vs. ~29k last year.
Quanta (2382.TW, OW): July revenue was NT$366.3B (-5% m/m, +131% y/y). We
attribute the m/m decline mainly to lower NB shipments, at 2.8M units (-38% m/m).
As for GB200/300 rack shipments in the month, we estimate Quanta delivered 2.2-
2.25K racks (-4% m/m) in July. Our full-year assumption is unchanged, at ~18.7K
racks.
Wistron (3231.TW, OW): July revenue was  NT$308.2B (-4% m/m, +61% y/y). We

attribute the m/m decline to: 1) lower NB shipment, at 1.6M units (-20% m/m); 2)
lower DT shipments, at 700K units (-13% m/m); 3) lower monitor shipments, at
900K units (-10% m/m); and 4) slightly lower GB200/300 server computing tray
shipments (1,150-1,200 rack equivalents, by our estimates, down 6% m/m), offset by
higher Wiwynn revenue, at NT$117.7B (+6% m/m, +39% y/y). Our full-year forecast
was raised to ~17.9K racks recently.
Hon Hai (2317.TW, OW): July revenue was NT$946.5B (+15% m/m, +54% y/y), with

all segments growing m/m, with server-related revenue seeing the strongest m/m
growth, followed by computing products, followed by components and other
products, and lastly the consumer segment, which mainly includes iPhone assembly.
We model HH's GB rack shipments at 3.6K racks (+9% m/m). Our full-year forecast
is unchanged, at ~31.7K racks.

Key Takeaways
We estimate GB200/300 rack output in July at ~8.0K (flattish m/m), within
which:
Quanta shipped 2.2-2.25K  GB200/GB300 racks.
Wistron shipped 1.1-1.2K GB200/GB300 racks.
Hon Hai shipped ~3.6K GB200/300 racks.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Hon Hai Precision (2317.TW)
Base case scenario value, derived from a residual income valuation model. Our key assump-
tions include a cost of equity of 8.5%, a medium-term growth rate of 13%, and a terminal
growth rate of 3%.
Risks to Upside
n Better-than-expected iPhone sell-through
n Faster progress in AI server business
n Faster EV business development progress
n Any new M&A activity that could improve sentiment

Risks to Downside
n Lower iPhone sell-through
n Smaller profit contribution from AI business
n Slower EV business development progress
n Geopolitical developments that could negatively affect foreign investment
Quanta Computer Inc. (2382.TW)
Base case, residual income model. Key assumptions include a cost of equity of 9.0% (beta of
1.2, equity premium of 6.0% and risk-free rate of 1.5%), an 8.5% medium-term growth rate, and
a 3% terminal growth rate.

Risks to Upside
n Stronger-than-expected NB demand
n Stronger-than-expected Apple Watch demand
n Stronger-than-expected server demand
n Faster-than-expected AI server penetration
Risks to Downside
n Weaker-than-expected NB demand
n Softer-than-expected Apple Watch demand
n Weak margin performance owing to rising labor costs and sales shortfalls
n Fierce price competition in the mega data center segment
n Slower-than-expected AI server penetration

### Page 1

ab 7 August 2026
Global Research
King Yuan Electronics
Riding on expanding TAM of Cloud AI volume
even with less growth in test time
Sales growth to accelerate in Q4 after softer Q3
We forecast KYEC’s Q3 sales to grow high single digits QoQ, below consensus estimate
of 16-17% QoQ. Q3 gross margin may also decline to 38-39% from 39.5% in Q2, due
to higher electricity and labor cost, and 1% dilution from the new Singapore fab. The
major Cloud AI accelerators are ramping up in Q3, albeit still in early stage. We expect

multiple Cloud AI accelerator programs to ramp meaningfully in Q4, to lift sales growth
to 15-20% QoQ. We estimate Q4 GM to also rise to 42-43% with higher utilization and
lower utility cost.
Larger Cloud AI TAM to support 2027E sales growth of 45%
Looking ahead, KYEC has planned clean room construction through end of 2027,
reflecting the rising testing demand from probing and final test from growing units of
server CPU, accelerators, networking etc. On final test time, the content for new major

Cloud AI accelerator may be flat to up slightly vs prior generation based on our estimate,
likely given the tight testing capacity and limited architectural change. Net, we forecast
KYEC’s sales to grow 45% in 2027E after 36% growth in 2026E.
Diversifying footprint in Singapore and the US
Given the geopolitical dynamics, KYEC is also enhancing its supply resilience by
diversifying its production base. The new Singapore fab just started mass production in

Q226. KYEC also recently announced its plan for the US expansion . In terms of
implication to profitability, our view is the dilution should be manageable if KYEC could
negotiate with key clients for tool consignment.
Valuation: Buy with lower target of NT$325
We lower 2026/27/28E EPS by 11-15% to factor in less meaningful increase of final test
time of Cloud AI chips, MediaTek’s TPU v8t order split with ASE, and higher OPEX
assumption. We lower our price target to NT$325 from NT$380, based on unchanged

22x 2027E PE. Maintain Buy rating.

from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: ITEQ released 2Q26 results after market hours on 7 August.

What’s the impact: 2Q26 results beat on stronger-than-expected 
gross margin. 2Q26 revenue grew 26% QoQ to TWD11.5bn mainly due to 
a solid price hike of 30% with a stable utilisation rate of 70-75%. 2Q26 net 
income of TWD1,279m (EPS: TWD3.52) was 71-118% higher than our 
estimate (TWD587m) and the consensus (TWD750m) due to a stronger-
than-expected gross margin. Gross margin expanded to 10.6pp to 22% in 
2Q26, while operating margin increased 11.4pp to 16% due to decent opex 
control. Net income was also boosted by a slightly lower tax rate of 30.2% 
(vs. 35% in 1Q26). In 2Q26, ITEQ had 60% of total sales from regular 
servers, with 10% from AI servers and 400G switches, per our estimates.

Business outlook. We believe the CCL industry is experiencing a 
favourable ASP trend from 2Q26 given that AI servers have continuously 
crowded out most of the tier-1 CCL capacities, as capacities are shifted 
from non-AI to AI to meet end demand. This has caused mid-to-low end 
orders to spill over to the next tranche that is currently benefiting E-glass 
vendors including ITEQ. We believe the E-glass price rose more than 80% 
in 1H26, which caused vendors to raise their ASP by 30% to pass on the 
cost to end customers. Looking ahead, we expect ITEQ to deliver revenue 
growth of c.20% QoQ in 3Q26 and 10% QoQ in 4Q26 as we expect it to 
keep passing on additional costs from E-glass price hikes (5-10% per 
month as of now). We believe these price hikes will continue into 1H27; in 
our view, the price hike impact from 2026 plus a likely 20% hike in 2027 
would cause 2027 revenue to grow 43% without a meaningful capacity 
increase. ITEQ today announced a new capacity expansion plan in Wuxi, 
which will likely increase its capacity by 2.85m. With the additional new 
capacity from Thailand (600k in 2028), its capacity will increase from 5.45m 
sheets in 2026E to 6.05m/8m/8.9m in 2027-2029E. Its capacity ramp-up is 
targeting high-end CCL demand from hyperscalers from 2028 onward.

What we recommend: We lift our 2026-28E EPS by 111-206% on price 
hikes. We lift our 12M TP to TWD600 (from TWD333), based on a target 
PER of 22x (higher than the range of its past-1-year range of 8-18x), applied 
to our 1-year-forward EPS forecast. We lower our PER target from 30x as we 
believe upside from price hikes has been partially priced in. Nonetheless, we 
upgrade the stock to Buy (1) from Outperform (2), as we believe ITEQ will 
gradually benefit from high-end CCL demand given the current supply-
demand situation. Key risk: weaker-than-expected regular server demand.

How we differ: Our 2026-27E EPS are 66-180% above consensus, mainly 
due to our more aggressive view on ITEQ’s revenue and margin profile.

7 August 2026

Upgrading: strong beat in 2Q26 with improving outlook

➢ Gross margin expanded significantly on favourable pricing trend  
➢ Massive capacity expansion indicates a resolution to tap into AI servers  
➢ Upgrading to Buy (1) rating; raising our 12-month TP to TWD600

Source: Daiwa forecasts

ASMedia
Valuation
Our target price for ASMedia of NT$1,650 is based on SOTP, with 22x 2026E EPS for ASMedia’s core business plus 13x 2026E
EPS for WT Micro contribution. Our TP implies blended 16x/13x 2026E EPS, which is lower than -1std of the past 5-year PE
range. We think this PE is justified by PC weakness likely continuing into 1H27E, GM pressure from inflation in 2H26E and
potential competition from a new peer in 2027E.

Risks
Key upside risks that could cause the shares to trade above our target price include a stronger-than-expected recovery in PC
demand, successfully passing on material price hikes to customers, better-than-anticipated momentum from USB4 products,
and rapid progress in the packet switch business. Conversely, key downside risks that could cause the shares to trade below
our target price include a slower-than-expected recovery in PC demand, failure to pass on material price hikes to customers,

weaker-than-expected momentum from USB4 products, and slow progress in the packet switch business.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

營收走勢圖

研究員/吳大任 TERRY.WU@uni-psg.com

研究部對譜瑞投資建議維持中立，係因(1)2Q26 毛利率再探底，獲
利不如預期，(2)3Q26 營收展望符合預期，惟毛利率有下修疑慮，
(3)ASIC LIKE 產品 4Q27 才會貢獻營收，比市場預期稍晚，(4)成
本提升速度快於調整產品價格 ， 故毛利率預測再下修 ， 連帶下修26
年獲利預估 。 綜合以上 ， 下修譜瑞26 年 EPS 預估為 32.99 元(原估
35.74 元，-4.4%YOY)，預估 27 年 EPS 為 38.19 元(+15.8%YOY)。
因毛利率預估下修 ， 加上此次法說會較少提到ACC 相關產品 ， 另外
ASIC LIKE 出貨時間點比市場預期晚，故仍維持中立投資建議，目
標價 678 元(27 年EPS *18XPER)。

重點摘要： 
1. 2Q26 毛利率再探底，獲利不如預期 
2Q26 譜瑞-KY 營收為落在財測區間約中間的 42.49 億元，
成長 6.5%QOQ， 成長3.3%YOY， 約略與原先預估的42.08 億
元相差不大。不過毛利率僅為 40.2%，相對先前預估的
41.2%有所差距 ， 主要係因譜瑞受到成本端漲價 ， 雖然有反
映出去，但不如成本提升的速度快所致。在毛利率不如預
期的狀況下，使得稅後淨利僅為 5.93 億元(原估 6.42 億
元)，成長 12.1%QOQ，衰退 15.5%YOY，EPS 7.51 元(原估
8.02 元)。2Q26 營收占比來看：DP(Display port, TCON) 
約 30%以上，PS(High speed) 約 45%，TC(DRIVER)10%以
下，TT(Touch) 約 15%。

2. 3Q26 展望符合預期，希望毛利率回升：  
譜瑞-KY 3Q26 給出營收 1.39 億至 1.53 億美元，成長
3.4%QOQ-成長 13.8%QOQ，隱含區間中值約成長 8.6%QOQ，
其中產品線中表現最好的將會是 TT，因為 TTED 產品銷售
狀況優於預期，產品在市場上目前無競爭對手所致；毛利
率介於40%至44%， 公司寄望2Q26 為全年毛利率低點 ，3Q26
將持續反映成本給客戶且優化產品設計，以提升毛利率。
營業費用約 3,300 萬至 3,600 萬美元。整體財測營收與先
前預估相當 ， 但毛利率仍有所下修 ， 故研究部預估3Q26 營
收為 47.21 億元(原估 46.8 億元)，成長 11.1%QOQ，成長
7.9%YOY，毛利率下修預估至 40.8%(原估 42.2%)，稅後淨
利同步下修預估為 7.85 億元(原估 8.41 億元)，成長
32.4%QOQ，衰退 3.7%YOY，EPS 9.94 元(原估 10.5 元)。

### Page 2

請參見末頁重要批露及免責聲明  2

3. 26 年成長性最高的產線來自於 TT 
2Q26 進入量產的 TTED 產品，因為貢獻幅度大於預期，使
得 2Q26 TT 產線提升至約當 15%。在法說會中，譜瑞表示，
原先預估該產品今年出貨量約高於 500 萬顆，但因為目前
產品仍無競爭對手，加上在帶筆觸控也開始與日本廠商合
作，故認為今年出貨量預估將提升至遠超過 500 萬顆。最
終目標譜瑞認為將可以達到整體筆電的 10%，約當是年出
貨量 1500 萬顆。綜合以上，推估譜瑞TT 產線營收將成長
約 50%YOY 以上。

4. ASIC LIKE 產品量產時間點將在 4Q27： 
譜瑞切入 CHIPSET 產品此次法說會也有證實，雖未提及
客戶名稱，但譜瑞表示目前有兩個產品進行研發，應該
會在今年下半年 TAPE OUT 產品。產品單價約在 10-20 美
元左右，而毛利率仍取決於產品良率，目前應該與公司
平均相近，未來將持續優化。而研究部目前仍以較保守
方式預估貢獻幅度，係因市場原估貢獻時間點落在
1H27，但現在可能要往後挪移至 4Q27 貢獻。

5. 26年獲利仍有下修風險，27年正向看待：  
有鑒於譜瑞2Q26營收符合預期，但毛利率仍受到壓抑，使
得獲利不如預期。而 3Q26財測營收也約略與先前預估相
當，但獲利仍有微幅下修，故研究部維持 26年營收預估
173.4億元(原估174.4億元)， 成長4.9%YOY， 但因為毛利率
下修故同步下修稅後淨利預估為 26.05億元(原估28.6億
元)， 衰退4.4%YOY，EPS 32.99元(原估35.7元)。 展望27年，
成本雖然可能持續提升，不過譜瑞 TTED持續放量，加上
ASIC LIKE產品即將出貨，故預估27年營收為187億元，成
長8.3%YOY，稅後淨利預估為30.17億元，成長15.8%YOY，
EPS 38.19元。

2Q26 獲利低於預期因 InP 基板缺貨及一次性費用 
環宇 2Q26 營收季增 8%至 7.7 億元，毛利率季減 11.3 百分點至 43.3%，
EPS 為 0.91 元，低於預期 36%；主要因(1) AOC( 光通訊)事業占比由前季
74%降至 61%影響毛利率，因其為毛利率最高之事業部且規模經濟減低；(2)
費用增加因發行員工限制權新股產生一次性費用。 3Q26 營收估季增 9%至
8.4 億元，EPS 估計為 1.48 元，較先前下修 5%及 21%，主因中國大陸基板
審批已通過的部份至 2026 年底無虞，然而 InP 基板估計 7 月及 8 月陸續到
貨在季初仍有部份影響。 
100G PD 持續出貨，新竹廠為 CW Laser 後段製程布局 
環宇在 100G PD 應用於 800G(100G*8)的光收發模組市占率約 70%，訂單
能見度已至 1Q27；已取得認證的 200G PD( 應用於 1.6T)則因市場 DSP 供
應較少而尚未明顯增長。CW Laser 70mW 已通過多位客戶認證，目前美國
廠小量交貨，未來量能放大將於新竹廠 (轉投資威力富)進行後段製程(鍍膜、
切割、測試)。RF 事業占營收比重估計客戶數量由 10 個以上降至 6 個，將
產能空出為 AOC 未來訂單準備，估計 2026 年及 2027 年占比 16%/6%，較
2025 年的 18%降低。 
長期看好維持買進，本益比調整考量基板不確定性 
本 中 心 估 計 2026/2027 年 營 收 年 增 48%/55% 至 33 億/50 億 元 ， 下 修
4%/10%，獲利下修 23%/12%至 EPS 5.6 元/15.1 元；主因對 InP 基板緊缺
而下修，公司表示已布局日系 InP 基板以降低單一原料供應風險。本中心估
計 2026/2027 年 AOC 占比為 71%/88%，較先前估的 78%/89%下修。參考
市場同業本益比倍數位於 40-60 倍，考慮上游基板不確定性下調目標本益比，
採估計 2027 EPS 以 40 倍目標本益比給予目標價 600 元(先前採 2027 EPS 
50 倍本益比)。 
元大觀點 
⧫  
2Q26 獲利低於預期，因 (1)InP 基板缺貨使 AOC 占比由 74%降至
61%，(2)發行員工限制權新股一次性費用。 
⧫  
InP 基板審批通過估計 3Q 陸續到貨至年底無虞；估計 2026 年獲利下
修 23%至 5.6 元，公司已佈局日系基板因應 2027 年需求。 
⧫  
估計 2026/2027 年營收年增 48%/55%；EPS 為 5.6 元/15.1 元，因基
板缺貨下修 23%/12%；採 2027 年 EPS 及 40 倍本益比給予目標價。

InP 基板已佈局其他供應商，降低不確定性風險 
InP 基板來源以美商 AXT 為主，其主要產能位於中國大陸，由於中國大陸審核批文的不確定性；公
司已佈局日系供應商，有助於 2027 年的基板供貨順暢。近期美系 InP 基板供應商 AXT 宣布擴充產
能由 2 倍增至 3 倍，日本的 Sumitomo 亦宣稱擴充一倍產能，顯示全球光通訊需求明顯增長，整上
游原料供需緊缺。 
環宇營運因 AOC 持續增長而轉佳，毛利率逐季向上走升 
估計 2026/2027 年營收年增 48%/55%，營收下修 4%/10%，獲利下修 23%/12%至 EPS 5.6 元
/15.1 元；主因對 InP 基板緊缺而下修，公司表示已布局日系 InP 基板以降低單一原料供應風險。
本中心估計 2026/2027 年 AOC 占比為 71%/88%，年增 52%/94%；成長動能來自 AOC 受惠於整
體市場需求，以及 CW Laser 對營運貢獻。

環宇-KY 主要應用產品為 RF 射頻元件晶圓代工 /光電元件晶圓代工 /自有產品光電元件 (AOC)：1) 
RF 射頻元件和電力電子晶圓代工(RF & Power Foundry) - 以砷化鎵、磷化銦及氮化鎵為晶圓材料，
主要應用於無線通訊產品的射頻電路，特別在無線通訊基地台、手機及衛星航太和國防所使用之高
階射頻元件；2) 光電元件晶圓代工(Opto Foundry) - 砷化鎵、磷化銦為晶圓材料，應用於光通訊、
醫學、穿戴式裝置、汽車雷達及工業； 3) 自有產品光電元件 (AOC；Advanced Optoelectronics 
Component) - 砷化鎵(GaAs)、磷化銦、砷化銦鎵 (InGaAs)光探測器(PIN PD) 、雷射二極體(Lasor 
Diode)、VCSEL，可應用於 100 Gbps、200 Gbps、400 Gbps、800 Gbps 和 1.6T 光通訊。

產業概況  
光收發模組中的光傳輸元件供應鏈含磊晶、晶圓製造、封裝及終端模組 
光傳輸元件係利用半導體光能及電能可相互轉換之特性，光纖是目前已知傳輸介質中速度最快的，
具備通信容量大、傳輸距離遠、抗電磁干擾、傳輸損耗低、信號串擾小、重量輕、保密性佳等優點，
是光傳輸的最佳選擇。三五族半導體磊晶相較於技術成熟的矽製程半導體特性不同， GaAs(砷化鎵)
及 InP(磷化銦)均為高電子遷移率的化合物半導體， InP 適用於更高頻率的高速光纖通訊， VCSEL
適用於短距光通訊傳輸，為 GaAs 製程。

光收發模組將於 800G 及 1.6T 高速成長且再向更高速邁進，產品升級且難度提升 
AI 推動全球資料使用量正急遽增長，對高速網路傳輸速率的需求持續攀升。光收發模組  (Optical 
Transceiver) 扮演關鍵角色，負責完成光信號與電信號之間的轉換與傳輸。隨著資料中心規模持續
擴張，未來對光收發模組的需求預計將與日俱增；由早期的 100G，逐步發展至當前的 400G、
800G，並邁向未來的 1.6T 乃至 3.2T。預期 400G 於 2025 年為主流出貨量估 3,200 萬個，800G
估計 2025/2026 年為 1,800 萬/3,500 萬個，1.6T 為 270 萬/1,300 萬個。估計 800G 以上的光收發
模組而言，2026 年 5500 萬個，2027 年為 1.05 億個；此外，估計全球 NPO/CPO 交換機的 Port
數於 2026 年為 100 萬個，2027 年為 500 萬個，2028 年為 1000 萬個，亦需搭配插拔式的模組。

資料傳輸朝更高速增長使 PIC 設計更重要；LPO 及 CPO 亦需插拔式光模組 
AI 交換機(Switch) 單埠（Port）的傳輸資料量主要取決於交換機的世代技術， 2026 年主流為單
Port 800G 的傳輸速率採 8 通道且單埠每秒可傳輸約 100 GB 的資料；1.6T（1.6 Tbps）採 8 通道
且單埠每秒可傳輸達 200 GB 的資料；未來若發展 3.2T 將採 8 通道且單埠每秒可傳輸達 400 GB 
的資料。CW Laser 由 PIC (Photonic Integrated Circuit)處理調變，故 PIC 的設計至關重要。 
此外，LPO（Linear-drive Pluggable Optics ，線性驅動可插拔光學）透過移除傳統光模組中的數位
訊號處理器（DSP），降低 50%功耗且降低延遲，並保有模組可插拔的靈活性， 800G/1.6T 高速
網路世代的熱門解決方案。CPO（Co-Packaged Optics ；共同封裝光學）光子積體電路（PIC）與
電子積體電路（ EIC）共同封裝在同一個載板上， Nvidia 已推出 CPO 之 AI 交換機(Switch)，採
ELSFP（External Laser Small Form Pluggable ，外接雷射光源模組），調變晶片靠近 ASIC 位置
以縮短傳輸距離及降低功耗； ELSFP 將容易受温度影響且壽命較短的雷射光源獨立出來，放在主
機板邊緣作為標準化插拔模組，不僅提升散熱效率，也解決 CPO 系統的維護難題。

建議：維持買進 
結論：母以子貴，2027 年獲利顯著改善

一、中美晶主要事業包含半導體、再生能源以及汽車元
件，其中以半導體營收占比最高  
中美晶成立於 1981 年，主要事業包含半導體、再生能
源以及汽車元件三大領域。持股 46.64%之環球晶圓
( 6488 TT)為半導體事業營運主體 ， 再生能源事業包含太
陽能電池模組製造、電廠投資以及儲能業務，至於車用
業務則以持股 24.58%的朋程為主體 。 半導體 、 再生能源
以及汽車元件占 1H26 營收比重分別為 82.6%、7.3%和
10%。此外，轉投資台特化(持股 30.09%)、宏捷科(持股
27.8%)和朋程分別於 3Q21、2Q22 和 4Q23 納入合併報
表中，至於先前虧損連連之兆遠已於 4Q23 被環球晶併
購。 
二、業外認列 Siltronic 金融評價利益，2Q26 EPS 3.19
元優於預期，3Q25 營收動能主要來自半導體矽晶圓 
2Q26 營收 211.1 億元(+9%QoQ)， 受到環球晶仍處產能
爬坡期影響，毛利率 22.7％低於前季之 23.2%，營業利
益 22.48 億元(-2%QoQ)低於預估值 21%，業外因認列
Siltroic 金融評價利益共計認列收入 32.16 億元，稅後純
益 19.59 億元(+74%QoQ)，EPS 3.19 元優於預期之 2.64
元。展望 3Q26，半導體矽晶圓新廠客戶認證通過數、
稼動率和生產效率皆將提升，估計 3Q26 營收 235.8 億
元(+12%QoQ)，稅後純益 11.44 億元(-24%QoQ)，EPS 
1.86 元。 
三、再生能源製造業務聚焦美國利基市場，服務業務在
手契約達千億元  
中美晶去年八月將再生能源業務劃分為製造(旭日)和服
務(續升)兩大領域，涵蓋太陽能、風力以及水力等再生
能源解決方案，其中提供再生能源銷售與服務之子公司
續升已登綠興櫃。在製造事業上將聚焦美國、日本和台
灣市場，針對屋頂、LEO 及淨零建築等高值應用發展，
並與聯合再生合資美國太陽能模組製造公司，總投資金
額約 4,000 萬美元，規劃年產能 1GW 服務在地市場。
至於再生能源服務業務 ， 累計簽約額逾1,000 億元 ，85%
以上合約年期超過 10 年，提供售電、節能、儲能與能源
管理整體方案，服務業務將為中美晶再生能源業務成長
主要動能。 
四、半導體矽晶圓業務產能利率用快速改善，美光長約
可望為後續 LTA 價格以及現貨價帶來定錨效應 
環球晶除新增產能以及 SiC 產線外 ，2Q26 12 吋、8 吋、
6 吋和 GaN 稼動率皆已接近滿載 ， 整體產能利用率快速
改善，全球新產能陸續完成且進入客戶驗證階段下將帶
來更多營收認列 ， 尤其美國廠可望受惠於地緣政治趨勢 ，
加計公司擴產主要針對 SOI、GaN、12 吋 SiC 和方形晶
圓等高附加價值產品擴產，可望優化長期產品組合。 
美光與環球晶簽訂十年 LTA，並提供 5 億美元策略性資
金支持環球晶美國擴產，除降低美國投資成本壓力，並
有助未來出貨價以及新簽訂 LTA 價格向上。此外，LTA
討論範圍擴展到邏輯和特殊晶圓產品，相較於前波景氣
高峰多討論規格和承諾價量，此次 LTA 納入矽晶圓生產
地協商，且期限更長，預期 LTA 預付款將於 1H27 顯著
提升 ，2027 年半導體矽晶圓出貨價格和獲利表現皆可望
顯著改善。 
五、維持買進理由 
1)預估中美晶 2025 和 2026 年 EPS 分別為 9.13 元和
14.01 元。 
2)考量母以子貴，2027 年獲利顯著改善，維持買進評
等,TP 225 元 (2027 PER x 16)。

竹陞科(6739.TT) 
長期受惠客戶擴廠與產品滲透率提升

研究部給予竹陞科買進投資建議 ， 係因 ： （1）未來五年還有超過 2 萬台Gobot
需求量，26-27 年 Gobot 高雙位數成長；（2） 受惠台系客戶擴廠需求，IoT 
與 Govision 成長性均有望優於 Gobot；（3） 未來將持續維持月增與高毛利
水準。 綜 上 所 述 ， 保 守 預 估 26/27 年 營 收 分 別 為 15.2/22.2 億元
(+88%YoY/+50%YoY)， 毛利率維持長年 68% 高水準 ， 預估 26/27 年稅後 EPS 
分別為 31.3/46.4 元。給予27 年 32 倍 PE，目標價1485 元，評等為買進。 
1. 月營收已維持連續 26 個月月增 
公司月營收自 6M24 起連續 26 個月增，複合月增率高達+6%，年化複合成
長率+101%。研究部預估 3Q26 營收 4.12 億元（15%QoQ，+86%YoY），公
司軟硬體系統整合方案，深厚護城河得以維持高毛利率水準 68.2%，預
期 3Q26 稅後 EPS 8.55 元。 
2. Gobot 持續成長，成為公司未來基本獲利 
展望未來，在半導體大擴廠的時代下，人力將成為最稀缺的資源之一，
製程自動化為長期趨勢。未來成長動能來自先進封裝與記憶體舊有的系
統轉換與擴廠需求，23 年公司切入美系客戶廠房標配設備，目前執行到
第四年已安裝 7000-8000 台，成為公司首波成長動能。隨著 AI 對於記
憶體需求帶動客戶擴廠增加 ， 公司預期未來五年還有超過 2 萬台的需求
量，預期 Gobot 26 年近翻倍成長，27 年再成長+50%YoY。 
3. 未來三年享受客戶擴廠與公司產品市占率提升 
同時公司預期 IoT 與 Govision 成長性都將優於 Gobot，主要來自台
系客戶擴廠需求。目前台系客戶仍屬部分製程標配部分選配，若未來全
廠轉為標配，潛在市場為目前的四倍大，未來成長具想像空間。綜上所
述 ， 保守預估26/27 年營收分別為 15.2/22.2 億元(+88%YoY/+50%YoY)，
預估 26/27 年稅後 EPS 分別為 31.3/46.4 元。

一、 公司簡介 
竹陞科技成立於 2017 年，9M24 上櫃，位於新竹竹北，為半導體智慧工廠 AIoT 軟
硬體系統整合公司。本土自研高科技產業製程硬體設備與軟體系統，主要產品為
智能自動化操作系統 （i-RPA） ，遠程操控系統 （RCM） 、製程數據採集系統 （AIoT）
及相關系統軟硬體整合。針對不同類型的機台設備，運用物聯網感應器、AI 機器
視覺、聽覺、嗅覺作資訊採集及 AI 異常檢測，確保機台設備正常運轉，穩定產
品良率品質，亦可遠程智能協同操控。目前員工人數為 129 人，研發和工程人員
接近 60%。主要客戶為國內外晶圓廠、記憶體、封測廠、PCB、面板光電等，間接
對手為工業電腦與人工解決方案。 1Q26 產品營收佔比為  Gobot (遠端操作
台)35%、GoVision （機台內部影像、聲紋與 VOC 即時監控）37% 與 loT 28%（數
據監控盒）。

圖一、 產品組合營收走勢

資料來源：統一投顧整理

竹陞 2H25 主要銷售市場為台灣（86%）、新加坡（11%） 、其他（3%）。主要客
群為半導體晶圓廠（67%）、記憶體廠（18%），以及部分面板與 PCB 廠，後續
台灣佔比與晶圓廠佔比有望持續提升。 其中記憶體廠與大型晶圓代工廠最關鍵 ，
這類客戶機台數多 、廠區多、 標準化需求高 ，一旦產品被列為標配 ，後續會隨新
廠 、 新機台與擴產持續放量。 應用上 ，記憶體與成熟製程因機台重複性高 、導入
阻力較低 ， 適合 Gobot 標準化部署 。 先進製程與封裝更重視污染 、 塗佈 、 氣泡 、
聲音、震動與影像異常，因此 GoVision 感官監測的價值更高。竹陞將從標準
化高的場域放量，再逐步往先進製程與封裝滲透。過往公司逾半營收來自兩大
客戶，隨著 25 年台系客戶擴廠之餘大舉導入新產品 Govision，營收佔比從 
50% 提升至 67%，使得 25 年延續過往營收翻倍的成長性。

二、 產業分析  
1. 人力短缺使得公司產品重要性不斷提升 
近年全球製造業面臨人力短缺，多數半導體、記憶體、先進封裝等工業
產線仍須24小時持續運轉。隨著 AI 發展，從下游組裝廠到上游零組件
廠均大舉宣布擴廠，擴廠計畫意味著投資資金、原物料、用地廠房、設
備與人力的增加均缺一不可，任一項目短缺都可能造成擴廠遞延。目前 
AI 供應鏈遇到原物料短缺，短缺原因除了來自設備、物料擴產不及，更
多來自人力短缺，因此人力已經不再是成本過高的層級，而是適當人力
不夠 。 長期供應鏈發展必須不斷提高廠房自動化滲透率 ， 降低人力依賴 、
減少人為失誤與提升效率。

2. 產品介紹 
竹陞科技產品即圍繞在半導體智慧製造，協助高科技製造業把工程師現
場巡檢、判斷與操作的工作遠端化、自動化與智慧化。公司將感測、資
料擷取、遠端操控、AI 判斷與自動化操作整合成智慧製造解決方案。軟
體、硬體主要由竹陞自行設計，製造與組裝部分委外，最後再由公司測
試、安裝與整合。

圖四、 公司產品演進

資料來源：公司、統一投顧整理

（1） IoT（數據監控盒 | 2017年） 
竹陞最早期產品為 IoT 製程數據採集系統。過去工廠若要確認
機台狀況，工程師必須進入無塵室、換裝、到機台旁查看，但許
多關鍵參數在機台內部，甚至原廠設計時不一定開放給使用者。
竹陞透過 IoT 感測與資料擷取，把機台內部的溫度、電流、震
動、氣體、運轉狀態等資訊收集上傳到系統，把過去僅靠人工經
驗判斷的設備狀態量化成可記錄、比對與預警的數據，且工程師
可在遠端即時看到機台狀況 ， 可即時判斷設備是否出現異常徵兆 。
提醒客戶提前安排更換，可降低非預期停機、減少報廢與提升稼
動率。 
（2） Gobot（遠端操作｜2018年） 
公司進一步發展出 Gobot 產品。過去工程師發現設備異常仍需
進入無塵室到機台旁處理。Gobot 結合先前 IoT 數據監控和收
集的數據，讓工程師在遠端以鍵盤滑鼠操作。除了解決人力親臨
現場的成本，Gobot 可降低人為操作失誤，系統會記錄工程師操
作過的動作、畫面與行為，把標準流程轉成 IRPA，與工程師協同
操作，降低新人不熟、人工判斷錯誤與輪班人力不足的問題，可
達到一人兼顧多台機台的效率。

### Page 5

請參見末頁重要披露及免責聲明 5

（3） GoVision（機台內部影像、聲紋與 VOC 即時監控｜2024年） 
機台運作時 ， 工程師通常無法在生產當下即時觀察機台內部狀況 ，
GoVision 將高速攝影機、麥克風、VOC 感測器等裝置放進機台，
將人的五官訊號數位化，記錄每一片產品的生產過程，把軌跡與
數據量化上傳。若某片晶圓在某個步驟中出現異常，例如製程中
瞬間發生的偏移、噴塗、裂片、位置變化或軌跡異常，工程師可
以即時發現，在更前段製程除錯節省龐大的成本。

圖五、 三大產品角色與定位

資料來源：公司、統一投顧整理

（4） 競爭優勢 
竹陞不僅位於工業電腦產業，更像取代晶圓廠原本的人工巡檢、
人工判斷與既有遠端控制流程。過往需透過工程師親自至機台查
看畫面、聽聲音、看參數，或使用 IP KVM、MES、SCADA、sensor 
系統做分散式監控。因此公司直接競品包括：廠內自建系統、人
工巡檢、既有 IP KVM 廠商、AI 檢測廠與廠務系統整合商。不過
多數競品只做單一環節，竹陞把資料擷取、影像監控、AI 判斷與
遠端代操整合成一套標準化方案。競爭優勢在於軟硬體整合與半
導體機台導入經驗。單一 KVM、感測或 AI 模型本身並非不可取
代，但要在晶圓廠內穩定運作，必須通過資安、製程安全、機台
相容性、權限管理與現場維護等門檻。竹陞已累積大量半導體設
備連線、遠端操作與異常處理經驗，能把不同品牌、不同介面的
機台接入同一套系統，使得客戶在不改變原本操作方式下，提升
即時監控能力，減少人力資源、人為失誤，同時避免與設備原廠
溝通 、 升級設備的成本 ， 甚至增加原廠設備所沒有的參數與功能 。
成為竹陞產品難以取代的產業護城河。

3. 23 年 Gobot 成為美系記憶體大廠標配，帶動公司大幅成長 
竹陞最早在 2019 年即與美系客戶有技術交流基礎，經過 3 年評估後， 
Gobot 正式成為美系客戶製程機台標配，前後段全廠機台均將搭配竹陞 
Gobot 設備 。 包括往後新廠與四五年一次的舊廠汰舊換新 。2H23 進入放
量階段，每廠潛在需求約 1500-2000 台 Gobot。美系客戶規劃 6 年內
交貨約 1.6 萬台，主要裝機需求來自新機落地 與舊式 KVM 汰舊換新。
受惠該客戶導入計劃，竹陞 24 年起營運大幅成長，營收 4.10 億元
（+61%YoY） 、稅後淨利 1.27 億元、EPS 6.03 元。25 年營收持續成長
至 8.06 億元（+96.7%YoY）、稅後淨利 3.75 億元、EPS 16.13 元。近
年月營收均呈現穩定向上趨勢，顯示近兩年營運進入高速成長期。

三、 營運展望 
1. 月營收已維持連續 26 個月月增 
2H23 起受惠美系客戶標配導入計劃，25 年起再加入台系客戶大單，公司月
營收自 6M24 起連續 26 個月增 ， 複合月增率高達+6%， 年化複合成長率+101%。
6 月營收 1.29 億元（+8%MoM，+101%YoY），單月稅後 EPS 2.77 元，符合預
期。研究部預估 2Q26 營收 3.59 億元（+26%QoQ，+100%YoY），公司軟硬體
系統整合方案，深厚護城河得以維持高毛利率水準，68.2% 約略與 1Q26 持
平，預期 2Q26 稅後 EPS 7.39 元。3Q26 月營收持續隨著客戶建廠安裝節奏

2. Gobot 穩定成長，成為公司未來基本獲利

求約 1500-2000 台。經過 3 年評估後，2H23 年 Gobot 正式成為美系記憶
體大廠製程機台標配，包括往後新廠與四五年一次的舊廠汰舊換新。客戶規
劃 6 年內交貨約 1.6 萬台。受惠該客戶導入計劃，竹陞 24 年起營運大幅
成長。目前每年約穩定交付 2000-3000 台，執行到第 4 年，交貨約 7000-
8000 台。隨著 AI 帶動 HBM 需求急速擴張，美系客戶也積極投入資本支出
擴廠。除了原先計畫，竹陞預期未來五年美系客戶對於 Gobot 需求量已從 
1.6 萬台上修至 2.5-3 萬台，扣除已交貨台數仍達 2 萬餘台。且新建廠房

3. 新產品 Govision 將成為公司未來主要成長動能 
新產品 Govision 機台端即時監控系統應用於高精度晶圓瑕疵偵測 、 光阻塗
佈監控、CoWoS 封裝段黏膠瑕疵、成品瑕疵檢測，透過即時提醒降低報廢率
與改善良率。未來成長動能來自台系與美系客戶擴廠時程與人力替代需求，
短期機會集中在後段先進封裝，目前公司已通過台系客戶驗證，成為 CoWoS

證與導入階段，該客戶有望同步導入前後段製程。整體來說，隨著  CoWoS 
reticle size 持續放大，客戶對噴塗均勻性、翹曲、黏膠瑕疵的即時監控
要求提高，有望受惠擴廠需求同時，同步提升 GoVision 在先進封裝與先進
製程中的滲透率。Govision 有望倍數成長，成長性優於 Gobot。

采鈺 (6789 TT) 
轉單效應份額提升，長線光通想像空間大

永豐觀點 
采鈺微型光學元件稼動率回升，隨 CIS 升級趨勢及份額提升 2H26 成長動能優於
1H26。長線光通相關應用持續與客戶開發中，具潛在成長想像空間，惟實際貢獻
時間尚未明朗，目前評價合理。 
 投資評價與建議 
維持中立投資建議：采鈺受惠 CIS 升級趨勢及韓系競爭對手轉單效應，CIS 動能穩
健稼動率持續維持在高檔；而因 MOE 新產品逐步放量及稼動率亦提升下，整體營
收獲利優於原先預期。惟以 2027 年稅後 EPS 7.02 元計算，本益比仍逾 65 倍，雖
長線光通應用想像空間大，但實際貢獻營收獲利時間尚未明朗，維持中立投資建
議。

ESG 評析 
采鈺企業永續評鑑整體為 A 等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向平
均得分分別為 A 等與 A 等。

采鈺為專業影像感測器代工廠 ：采鈺為國內專業影像感測器代工廠， 母公司台積電
持股 67%，2Q26 產品組合為影像感測器 (75%)、微型光學元件 (24%)以及其他
(1%)，終端應用占比為行動裝置(68%)、安控(20%)以及車用(12%)。主要競爭對手
為 Samsung、Sony、T oppan等廠商；主要客戶包含豪威、格科微、思特威、匯
頂等 CMOS 與指紋觸控晶片設計廠商。公司生產基地位於新竹、中壢及龍潭年產
能約當 8”晶圓 270 萬片。 
2Q26 毛利率 30.53% 較上季下滑 1.71 個百分點 ：采鈺 2Q26 稅後 EPS 1.45 元，
單季毛利率 30.53% 雖優於原先預估但較上季下滑。研究部評估，係因本季微型
光學元件產品如金屬層環境光感測器、零階光的 Proximity Sensor 逐步出貨，目
前 MOE 稼動率預估回升至 3 成以上，惟毛利率仍較 CIS 低在產品組合變化影響
下，使毛利率較上季下滑。預估 CIS 稼動率仍在 90% 以上高檔水準。整體而言，
1H26 在 CIS 部分受韓系 IDM 廠記憶體產能排擠影響，獲得轉單效應使安控營收
占比提升，而中低階手機 CIS 市佔亦有增加，產品線保持穩定成長。亦因MOE 新
產品逐步放量及稼動率提升下營收獲利優於原先預期。 
2H26 進入手機備貨旺季，MOE 產能利用率持續增加：展望 2H26，管理階層表
示手機 CIS 規格持續升級，200M 畫素產品已有客戶預計在下半年量產，稼動率持
續維持在高檔，亦因採用 Low-n Grid 製程，ASP 將獲得提升。MOE 部分，高階
手機用金屬層環境光感測器持續放量，預期稼動率可再較 1H26 回升。預估采鈺
3Q26 單季營收 26.25 億元(+7.5%QoQ，+16.4%YoY)，毛利率可再較 1H26 微
幅增加至 33.75%，惟因所得稅率影響預估稅後淨利 4.49 億元(-2.39%QoQ，
+29.7%YoY)，稅後 EPS 1.41 元。
